여행하다.m: to travel, to take a trip
여행하다.x: I traveled around Jeju Island last summer.
여행하다.t: Place + 을/를 여행하다 (travel around), or place + 에 여행을 가다 (go on a trip to).

신용카드.x: Can I pay by credit card here?
신용카드.t: People usually just say 카드: "카드로 할게요" means "I'll pay by card."

수학.ex: 수학 문제가 너무 어려워서 못 풀었어요.
수학.x: The math problem was too hard, so I couldn't solve it.
수학.e: Literally 'number study'. -학 = field of study: 수학, 과학, 경제학.
수학.t: Don't confuse with 수학여행 'school field trip'; that 수학 means 'cultivating learning', a different Sino-Korean word.

예습하다.m: to prepare for a lesson, to preview
예습하다.x: I previewed the material we're going to learn tomorrow.

부탁드리다.ex: 다음 주에 일이 있어서 사장님께 휴가를 부탁드렸어요.
부탁드리다.x: I have something going on next week, so I asked my boss for time off.
부탁드리다.e: 부탁 'favor' plus humble 드리다 'to give (to a superior)'.
부탁드리다.t: Humble form: use it when asking someone older or higher in rank; the person asked takes 께.
rel: I look forward to working with you

얻다.m: to get, to gain, to obtain; to receive (for free)
얻다.ex: 이번 여행에서 좋은 경험을 많이 얻었어요.
얻다.x: I gained a lot of good experiences on this trip.

출장.x: I'm going on a business trip to Busan next week.
출장.e: 출 means 'go out' — work done away from the office.
출장.t: Say 출장을 가다 'go on a business trip'; 출장 중 means 'away on business'.

담당자.x: Please ask the person in charge directly for details.
담당자.e: -자 = person who does it: 담당자, 과학자, 기술자.
담당자.t: Handy phrase on the phone: 담당자 좀 바꿔 주세요 'May I speak to the person in charge?'

천장.ex: 이 방은 천장이 높아서 넓어 보여요.
천장.x: This room has a high ceiling, so it looks spacious.
천장.e: Literally 'sky barrier,' the thing that blocks the sky indoors.
천장.t: The correct spelling is 천장, not 천정, a very common mistake.

활동하다.m: to be active, to work (as), to take part in activities
활동하다.ex: 그 가수는 요즘 미국에서 활동하고 있어요.
활동하다.x: That singer is working in the US these days.

불행.x: That accident was a great misfortune for the family.
불행.t: In fast speech the ㅎ weakens after ㄹ, so it often sounds like [부랭].

움직임.ex: 그 선수는 움직임이 아주 빠르고 가벼워요.
움직임.x: That player's movements are very quick and light.
움직임.e: 움직이다 'to move' + -ㅁ, which turns verbs into nouns.

해석.x: This sentence is a bit hard to interpret.

꽃다발.x: On graduation day I gave my friend a bouquet.
꽃다발.t: Pronounced [꼳따발]: final ㅊ sounds like ㄷ and makes the next ㄷ tense. Bouquets are a must at Korean graduations, and flower stalls pop up outside schools on the day.

채식주의자.x: I'm a vegetarian, so I don't eat meat.
채식주의자.t: Pronounced [채식쭈의자] or [채식쭈이자]: ㅈ turns tense after ㄱ, and 의 after the first syllable may sound like 이. Many Korean dishes use meat or fish broth, so ask: 고기 들어가요?

혈액 검사.ex: 혈액 검사 결과는 일주일 후에 나와요.
혈액 검사.x: The blood test results come out in a week.
혈액 검사.t: Pronounced [혀랙 검사]; in casual speech people say 피 검사.

헌법.x: The constitution guarantees the freedom of all citizens.
헌법.t: Pronounced [헌뻡]; 제헌절 (July 17) marks the adoption of Korea's constitution in 1948.

만족감.ex: 이 일을 하면서 큰 만족감을 얻어요.
만족감.x: I get a lot of satisfaction from doing this work.
만족감.e: Literally 'the feeling of being full and having enough'.

곰팡이.x: Mold has grown on the bathroom wall.
곰팡이.e: In Korean, mold 'blooms' like a flower: 곰팡이가 피다.

반칙.x: That player committed a foul and was sent off.
반칙.t: Used outside sports too: 반칙이야! means 'That's not fair!' or 'No cheating!'

질량.x: Mass does not change even when the location changes.
질량.t: Don't confuse with 무게 'weight', which changes with gravity; 질량 stays the same.

성평등.ex: 많은 회사가 성평등을 위해 제도를 바꾸고 있어요.
성평등.x: Many companies are changing their policies for gender equality.
성평등.t: Government documents often prefer 양성평등; 성평등 is the broader everyday term.

문맹.ex: 한글 덕분에 한국의 문맹률은 매우 낮습니다.
문맹.x: Thanks to Hangeul, Korea's illiteracy rate is very low.
문맹.t: -맹 forms playful words like 컴맹, someone hopeless with computers.

거듭하다.m: to repeat, to do over and over
거듭하다.ex: 그 팀은 실패를 거듭한 끝에 마침내 성공했어요.
거듭하다.x: After failing again and again, the team finally succeeded.
거듭하다.t: Pronounced [거드파다]. Pattern: N을/를 거듭한 끝에 'after repeated N.'

추궁하다.m: to question closely, to grill, to press (for an explanation or accountability)
추궁하다.ex: 경찰은 용의자에게 그날 밤의 행적을 추궁했습니다.
추궁하다.x: The police grilled the suspect about his whereabouts that night.
추궁하다.e: Literally 'chase to the end' — pressing until the truth comes out.

궁극적으로.ex: 우리의 목표는 궁극적으로 모두가 행복한 사회를 만드는 것입니다.
궁극적으로.x: Our goal, ultimately, is to create a society where everyone is happy.

성심성의껏.x: I will carry out my duties with all my heart.
성심성의껏.e: Literally 'with full sincere heart and sincere intent'.

사리사욕.ex: 정치인이 사리사욕을 채우면 국민의 신뢰를 잃습니다.
사리사욕.x: When politicians pursue personal gain, they lose the public's trust.
사리사욕.t: Collocation: 사리사욕을 채우다 'to line one's own pockets.'

꿩 먹고 알 먹기.forms: 꿩 먹고 알 먹기다 · 꿩 먹고 알 먹는 셈이다
꿩 먹고 알 먹기.m: killing two birds with one stone; a double benefit
꿩 먹고 알 먹기.ex: 운동도 하고 돈도 버니까 꿩 먹고 알 먹기예요.
꿩 먹고 알 먹기.x: I get exercise and earn money too—it's killing two birds with one stone.
꿩 먹고 알 먹기.e: Eat the pheasant and its eggs too: two gains from one catch.
꿩 먹고 알 먹기.t: Sino-Korean equivalents are 일석이조 and 일거양득; the proverb sounds more casual.

호경기.x: In a boom, jobs increase and spending goes up too.

재생 에너지.ex: 정부는 재생 에너지 사용을 늘리려고 합니다.
재생 에너지.x: The government plans to increase the use of renewable energy.
재생 에너지.e: Literally 'reborn energy'; 에너지 is from English 'energy.'
재생 에너지.t: In official documents you'll often see 신재생 에너지, 'new and renewable energy.'

탄소 발자국.ex: 대중교통을 이용하면 탄소 발자국을 줄일 수 있어요.
탄소 발자국.x: Using public transportation can reduce your carbon footprint.
탄소 발자국.e: A translation of English 'carbon footprint'; 발자국 = 발 'foot' + 자국 'mark.'

문책하다.x: The president sternly held the person responsible for the accident accountable.

잠재의식.ex: 어릴 때의 기억이 잠재의식 속에 남아 있을 수 있어요.
잠재의식.x: Childhood memories can remain in the subconscious.

연명치료.ex: 할머니는 연명치료를 원하지 않는다고 미리 밝히셨어요.
연명치료.x: Grandma made it clear in advance that she didn't want life support.

율격.ex: 시조는 정해진 율격에 맞춰 써야 해요.
율격.x: Sijo must be written to a fixed meter.
율격.e: Literally 'law pattern' — the fixed rhythmic rules of verse.

음정.m: interval; pitch accuracy, being in tune
음정.ex: 노래는 잘하는데 높은 음에서 음정이 자꾸 틀려요.
음정.x: She sings well, but she keeps going off pitch on the high notes.
음정.e: Literally 'sound distance': the gap between two notes.
음정.t: 음정이 불안하다 or 음정이 틀리다 is how Koreans say someone sings off-key.

불협화음.ex: 새 정책을 두고 정부 안에서 불협화음이 생겼습니다.
불협화음.x: Discord arose within the government over the new policy.
불협화음.t: In the news it usually means friction between people or groups, not music: 불협화음이 나다/생기다.

탕평책.ex: 영조는 탕평책을 실시해 인재를 고르게 등용했어요.
탕평책.x: King Yeongjo carried out the Tangpyeong policy, appointing talent evenly from all factions.
탕평책.e: From a classic phrase meaning 'broad and level', fair to every side.
탕평책.t: The dish 탕평채 (mung bean jelly salad) is said to be named after this policy.

부화뇌동.m: blindly following others, going along with the crowd
부화뇌동.ex: 남의 말에 부화뇌동하지 말고 스스로 판단하세요.
부화뇌동.x: Don't just blindly follow what others say; judge for yourself.
부화뇌동.e: Literally 'echoing along when thunder sounds' — agreeing without thinking.

은인자중.m: patiently holding back, enduring quietly with self-restraint
은인자중.ex: 그는 기회가 올 때까지 은인자중하며 때를 기다렸어요.
은인자중.x: He held back patiently and waited until the opportunity came.
은인자중.e: Literally 'hide feelings, endure, and carry oneself with dignity'.

진작하다.m: to boost, to stimulate, to raise (morale, an economy)
진작하다.ex: 정부는 내수를 진작하기 위한 대책을 발표했습니다.
진작하다.x: The government announced measures to boost domestic demand.
진작하다.t: Homonym: the adverb 진작 means 'earlier, long before' as in 진작 말하지.

유약하다.ex: 그는 성격이 너무 유약해서 결정을 잘 못 내려요.
유약하다.x: He's so soft-natured that he struggles to make decisions.

심층.ex: 이 문제에 대해서는 심층 분석이 필요합니다.
심층.t: Often used before a noun: 심층 분석, 심층 면접, 심층 취재.

조응.ex: 건물의 디자인이 주변 자연과 잘 조응해요.
조응.x: The building's design harmonizes well with the surrounding nature.

무릉도원.ex: 그 섬은 마치 무릉도원처럼 평화롭고 아름다웠어요.
무릉도원.x: The island was as peaceful and beautiful as an earthly paradise.
무릉도원.e: From a Chinese tale of a fisherman who found a hidden village beyond a peach-blossom stream.
